name: Tsunde-reijou Tachibana Amane to Vacance Ai-Land ~Jirojiro Misugi Desu wa! ...Kozukuri Shitain Desu no? Koibito Nan Dakara Suki ni nasai!~
original_name: ツンデ令嬢立花天音とバカンス愛ランド～ジロジロ見すぎですわ！…子作りしたいんですの？恋人なんだから好きになさい！～
source:
Protagonist Akito was a student who clashed daily with tsundere rich girl Ayane Tachibana.
One day he found himself the begrudging partner of her holiday trip.
She secretly had feelings for him, but would never say so directly.
Clumsily they confirmed the feelings were mutual, and the secluded beach was their paradise. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057169.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主角明人是一名学生，每天都与傲慢的富家女立花绫音发生冲突。
有一天，他发现自己成为她假期旅行的不情愿的伙伴。
她暗自对他有感情，但绝不会直接说出来。
他们笨拙地确认了感情是相互的，僻静的海滩就是他们的天堂。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057169.html]DLsite English[/url]]
